# minimax-mcp

> Local stdio MCP server and Agent Skill for MiniMax Code on macOS.

Five tools expose runtime status, session history and search, native agent tasks, Bot Studio conversations, and questionnaires. The runtime SQLite database is read-only. Targeted native session control uses Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP).

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/README.md) — Requirements, client setup, CDP, and verification commands.
- [Agent Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/skills/minimax-mcp/SKILL.md) — Session, Bot Studio, and questionnaire workflows.
- [Tool reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/skills/minimax-mcp/references/mcp-surface.md) — Arguments, result fields, and compatibility.
- [JSON-RPC examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/skills/minimax-mcp/references/mcp-call-examples.json) — Calls for the five advertised tools.
- [Full documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/llms-full.txt) — Standalone English overview.
